name: Can you patch drywall in a mobile home like a regular house?

mainEntity.name: Can you patch drywall in a mobile home like a regular house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can repair drywall in a mobile home, but the technique depends on what is currently installed. Many manufactured homes feature vinyl-covered gypsum wall panels (VOG) with plastic batten strips rather than traditional taped sheetrock. If you have standard sheetrock, typical patching, mudding, and sanding apply. If you have vinyl panels, a technician must either patch the panel directly or remove the batten strips, tape the seams, and skim coat the surface. A hands-on contractor like Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling inspects the wall backing first to ensure repairs do not crack under normal structure movement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but mobile homes often have vinyl-covered gypsum panels instead of standard sheetrock, which requires specialized seam taping or surface patching to hold properly.
